scene: The merchant gifts you transit tokens with the key.
picture: Along a stone transit platform, a glass cable car waits on the far left. Left of centre, the player stands holding her red umbrella and a brass key. In the centre, the lizard merchant waves. A yellow street tram sits right of centre, and a blue harbour ferry docks on the far right.
shown: A glass cable car waiting on the far left platform
A yellow street tram stopped with open doors right of centre
A blue harbour ferry moored at the dock on the far right

variants.scene: Key secured! Three warm transit lines await in the lantern-lit caverns.
Holding the brass key, you wonder if {quest} waits down one of these routes.
The friendly reptile waves farewell beside the rumbling engines and gentle water.
